QuestInfo.name: The Lost Snipe
QuestInfo.0: A #p9000043# that has been separated from his flock is looking for help...
QuestInfo.1: A snipe that was migrating to a warmer place got lost and is now separated from his flock. He wants to fly towards his friends but he can only take off by jumping off the #bJump Stand#k... To help the Snipe, talk to him using the keyword #bHelp the Snipe#k.
QuestInfo.2: You helped the Snipe get up the branch. He should now be able to jump and take off. But why do you feel so uneasy...

0.0: Hello! The sun is radiant and the eggs are growing nicely...it sure is a nice day isn't it? But why do I look so depressed, you ask? It's because the warm weather led me to fly into Maple World, and now I am lost. I don't know where my friends went... I wonder where they must have flown to by now... What? Why don't I just follow after them?
0.1: Well, I would like to! But...I can't. The truth is, I'm not really that great at flying yet. Of course, I know the basics. But my wings just aren't that strong! If I can descend from greater heights, I'm sure I'd be able to fly all I want!
0.2: But going to a high place isn't that easy. In order to climb up high on the tree branches, I have to jump over monsters, but I'm afraid of both jumping and monsters! Say, do you think you could lend me a hand?

yes.0: Ah, thank you so much! Talk to me using the keyword, #bHelp the Lost Snipe#k.

no.0: Oh, I see. Does that mean I'm stuck here forever...?

1.0: I'm... I'm so sorry! You went out of your way to help me, but I failed to jump. Wahhhh! What am I going to do? At this rate, I'll never catch up to my friends!

yes.0: *Sniff sniff* Oh, how I would love to go to the platform one more time. I think I'd be able to fly successfully this time...
